entries.en: All those drones buzzin’ around, night after night.
entries.ro: Dronele alea care bâzâie pe-acolo, noapte de noapte.

entries.en: Like someone’s drilling right into my brain.
entries.ro: Parcă mi-ar fora cineva direct în creier.

entries.en: What about those sensedep BDs? Maybe give one of those a scroll?
entries.ro: Ce zici de BD-urile alea sensedep? Dăm un scroll la vreunul?
